scope: Adversarial runtime, request accounting, approval and recovery boundaries, evaluation protocol and scorer counterexamples; no implementation or documentation authored by reviewer.

formal_plan_audit.execution: Offline Python assertions against load_dataset() and make_plan(formal=True); no model run.
formal_plan_audit.same_total: Every paired task grants A=B=C=8 total physical requests.
formal_plan_audit.extra_classifier: Every paired task grants A=8, B=C=9 or 10 according to explicit clarification allowance.

tests.model_boundaries: Synthetic telemetry contexts only; true subprocess os._exit interruptions and production filesystem tools.

verified_invariants: Misclassified system/unsupported advice leaves every original tool available and writes require exact action approval.
Unknown labels cannot authorize shell execution.
Short clarification answers preserve the original request, explicit negations and persisted intent mode after restart.
Classifier failures and internal retries consume shared physical request budgets; outer or task cap rejection creates no phantom physical request.
A true process kill inside an admitted synthetic model boundary preserves the request reservation and charges interrupted work on restart.
A true process kill after append is reconciled without append replay or repeated intent classification.
Changed live source content invalidates an approved copy before any destination effect.
Requirement correction invalidates an already granted pending approval and records a new intent revision.
Quoted file text and failed observations cannot ground environment-derived paths.
Oversized advisory intent is discarded before real observations or original user constraints.
Independent end-state scorer rejects missing files despite runtime.succeeded.
Independent protocol scorer rejects missing second input read, mismatched approval identity and reused grant even when final files match.
Actual append-then-read execution is rejected when the original request requires read-before-append, even though final bytes are correct.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Original post-return accounting could lose physical model budget on process kill.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Durable pre-transport admission, completion callback, uncertain outcome records and interrupted-time recovery; subprocess counterexample passes.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Large advisory intent could evict actual observations before itself being discarded.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Advisory is now dropped before real evidence trimming; independent oversized advisory test passes.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Context provenance was initially only a model assertion.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Context-derived object paths must occur in relevant successful or verified task evidence; live freshness remains enforced by tools and approval preconditions.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Protocol grading initially accepted approval by action ID without checking identity or consumption.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Scorer checks exact identity and single-use grants; independent tampered-trace tests pass.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Tool-name-only read requirements would miss a required second source file.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Scorer checks required read targets against authored fixture actions; missing b.txt read is independently rejected.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Explicit operation dependencies were initially not graded when reversed actions produced identical final bytes.
review_findings_resolved.initial_counterexample: 18-test review run initially had one failure: reference_append_en with only the scripted planner actions reordered to append-then-read was incorrectly accepted; request, gold dependencies and expected bytes were unchanged.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Scorer now matches frozen gold operations to actual successful tool-observation chronology and validates each dependency; final independent 18-test run passes. Saved-evidence regrading needs no new model requests.

limitations: Passing scripted and synthetic-boundary tests establishes execution and evaluation wiring, not classifier accuracy or overall task improvement.
Context provenance checks establish prior path occurrence, not correct referent selection or current freshness; planner and live tools remain responsible.
Interrupted active time conservatively includes possible downtime up to the remaining allowance.
Lexical answer and clarification checks are deliberately bounded fixture checks, not a general semantic judge.
Formal paired heldout comparison and default-switch acceptance have not been independently run; baseline should remain the default.
